semantics.catalogueDate: Original descriptive expression. Index bounds support catalogue retrieval and do not independently establish an event date or duration.
semantics.place: The role defines what a place describes. Null coordinates carry no position. All names and coordinates are fictional test values.
semantics.attribution: Each attribution belongs to the stated role and retains its qualifier. Shared labels do not identify a single entity.
semantics.production: How the particular field was supplied. A null review records no review. Production by an LLM does not supply a verification outcome.

provenance.transformations: Selected records are copied without field changes; display formatting is not written into source records.
